name: srali mazali vjazali
source:
Dive into the world of anime with colorful characters! Be in the body of a Japanese schoolgirl and do a school project with your friends! Learn a lot of new things with the game "Srali Mazali Vyazali"!

[From [url=https://golozhopiki-corporation.itch.io/srali]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
与色彩缤纷的角色一起潜入动漫世界！化身为日本女学生，和朋友们一起完成学校项目！通过游戏“Srali Mazali Vyazali”学习很多新东西！

[来自[url=https://golozhopiki-corporation.itch.io/srali]Itch.io[/url]]
